walkthroughs.title: Get Started with api-ape
walkthroughs.description: Learn how to use api-ape IntelliSense to supercharge your API development

steps.title: Verify api-ape Project
steps.description:
Make sure your project has `api-ape` in package.json dependencies. The extension activates automatically when detected.

[Check package.json](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%22package.json%22)

media.markdown:
## Project Detection

The extension looks for:
- `api-ape` in dependencies/devDependencies
- `.api-ape` directory
- `.api-ape.json` config file

steps.title: Start Your api-ape Server
steps.description:
For live schema updates, start your api-ape server. The extension fetches schema from `/api/ape/schema`.

Alternatively, generate types offline with the Generate Types command.

media.markdown:
## Schema Sources

1. **Running Server** (recommended): Live updates
2. **Local File**: `.api-ape/schema.json`
3. **Generated**: From controller files

steps.title: Explore Your Endpoints
steps.description:
Open the api-ape panel in the Activity Bar to see all your endpoints organized by namespace.

[Open api-ape Explorer](command:workbench.view.extension.apiApeExplorer)

media.markdown:
## API Explorer

- Browse endpoints by namespace
- Click to jump to controller
- Insert API calls with one click

steps.title: Use IntelliSense
steps.description:
Type `api.` in any JavaScript/TypeScript file to see endpoint suggestions. Use Tab or Enter to accept.

Hover over endpoints for documentation.

media.markdown:
## IntelliSense Features

- **Completions**: `api.` triggers suggestions
- **Hover**: See endpoint documentation
- **Signature Help**: Parameter hints
- **Go to Definition**: Ctrl/Cmd+Click

steps.title: Generate TypeScript Types
steps.description:
Generate type definitions for full TypeScript support.

[Generate Types](command:apiApe.generateTypes)

media.markdown:
## TypeScript Integration

Generated files in `.api-ape/`:
- `api-ape.d.ts`: Type declarations
- `schema.json`: Schema snapshot

Add to tsconfig.json:
```json
{ "include": [".api-ape/**/*"] }
```
